summary: Delta Hardware is the twenty-fourth studio album by blues harp player and vocalist Charlie Musselwhite, released in 2006 on Real World Records. It was his second release on the label, following Sanctuary in 2004. Musselwhite also plays electric guitar on the track "Town to Town".
one_line: Delta Hardware is Charlie Musselwhite's 2006 studio album, his twenty-fourth and second for Real World Records.
